newsitem.title: USA: Conrail wants to amend deal to $115 share.
newsitem.headline: Conrail wants to amend deal to $115 share.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it will negotiate amendments to its planned merger with CSX Corp so that Conrail shareholders will receive $115 per share at the earliest possible date.

"While the board expressed its disappointment that recent events indicate that all the strategic goals reflected in the merger agreement with CSX may not be attainable, the board expressed confidence that the final resolution will be beneficial to all the company's constituencies," Conrail said in a news release.

"In light of these developments, the board also authorized its management and representatives to negotiate amendments to the CSX merger agreement that would assure that the Conrail shareholders receive $115 in cash per share at the earliest possible date," the company said.

Conrail also said that the board has enhanced severance packages for employees not covered by collective bargaining agreements. It also said it took action regarding bonuses that would entice employees to remain at the company through the end of a transaction.

The statement confirmed signs given over the weekend that the four-month takeover battle for Conrail is likely nearing an end. Industry sources anticipate that CSX will buy Conrail and then divide the assets with rival bidder Norfolk Southern Corp.
The existing merger pact between Conrail and CSX is valued at $9.6 billion, or $108 a share, in cash and stock. Norfolk Southern has offered to buy Conrail for $115 in cash, or $10.3 billion.
